protocol.scientific_endpoint: per-episode joint pass: Uc and Wc raw20x8 bitwise equal, and Uc-vs-Vc chunk16x8 exceeds at least one legacy bound, in each of P1 P2 P3
protocol.global_gate: 27/27 primary episodes; 3 known episode0 units excluded from primary
protocol.statistical_test: none; census of fixed nonrandom cohort, descriptive count; no p-value or population CI
protocol.multiplicity: one conjunctive global gate; secondary metrics descriptive only
protocol.integrity_gate: raw20x8 bitwise equal U=U_exp=Uc=U_replay and Uc=Uc_replay; cache unchanged; selected pixels, semantic identities, query prompt and selection match P1 reference
protocol.retention: 25 endpoint-uniform relevant frames; distractor source indices0,248 for each of3 distractors; Q0; total32frames,512tokens
protocol.dry_run: D0 on 3 known episode0 units after freeze; integrity gates required for all three, and previously observed canonical Uc=Wc bitwise recovery must reproduce for VideoUnmask_ep0 and InsertPeg_ep0 before any primary episode is authorized. VideoPlaceOrder_ep0 has no new canonical-recovery gate. Dry outcomes are engineering validation only; they do not alter the original Stage4D 1/3 result or count toward the 27 primary units.
protocol.retry_policy: No automatic retries or overwrites. Infrastructure/integrity failure aborts affected run. Preserve outputs. A corrected run requires versioned amendment and new output root; previously observed units cannot be described as unseen. No replacement episodes. Never retry a valid scientific negative.
protocol.runtime_binding: freeze binds Python executable, pip freeze, GPU/driver signature, selected runtime flags, and PYTHONPATH; run verifies the same values before inference
